name: yourwebtraffic Analytics
author: dennisinele

sections.description:
yourwebtraffic Analytics helps you integrate privacy friendly website analytics into your WordPress site.

This plugin lets you add your personal tracking key from yourwebtraffic.de and automatically loads the tracking script on your website.

Features:
* Simple setup
* No manual script embedding
* Privacy friendly analytics
* No cookies
* Built for WordPress
* Made in Germany

External services

This plugin connects to the yourwebtraffic service to provide website analytics.

What the service is used for:
The service is used to collect website analytics data for the site owner.

What data is sent and when:
When a visitor loads a page where the plugin is active, the visitor’s browser loads the tracking script from https://yourwebtraffic.de/t.js.
This may result in analytics-related data being transmitted to the yourwebtraffic service, such as the visited page URL, referrer information, browser and device information, and anonymized IP-related information.

Service provider:
yourwebtraffic

Terms of Service:
https://yourwebtraffic.de/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://yourwebtraffic.de/privacy

Privacy

This plugin loads an external script from yourwebtraffic.de.

When activated and configured with a tracking key, the plugin sends requests to the yourwebtraffic service so website analytics can be generated for the website owner.

Please make sure that you inform your website visitors accordingly in your privacy policy if required.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your WordPress installation
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Open Settings > YourWebTraffic
  4. Enter your tracking key
  5. Save your settings
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

It connects your WordPress website with your yourwebtraffic account by loading the tracking script automatically after you enter your tracking key.

Does this plugin load external resources?

Yes. The plugin loads the tracking script from yourwebtraffic.de.

Do I need an account?

Yes. You need an account at yourwebtraffic.de and a valid tracking key.
